canonical_name: Second Saturday Salons at Jeffrey Burroughs (boutique open house)
summary: Jeffrey Burroughs is a fine jewelry and design boutique at 20 Artful Way in Asheville's River Arts District. Its 'Second Saturday Salon' is a monthly retail open house where the studio previews new jewelry and fragrance collections with light bites and champagne; it is part of the River Arts District's broader 'Second Saturday' shopping event. Only the host business recurs, and attendees are walk-in shoppers, collectors, and visitors rather than a fixed membership.

evidence.note: Listings across both units describe an 'artist salon' and 'gallery gathering' with no membership language, dues, or named regulars, just a monthly studio open house.

Explore Asheville's own event page describes it as an open-house gathering giving 'a first look at new collections, one-of-a-kind pieces' with refreshments and explicitly 'No RSVP required. Simply join us,' i.e. open to any walk-in.
Asheville.com's coverage frames it as a 'drop-in art, design and shopping stop' aimed at 'shoppers and collectors,' i.e. a retail/commercial event, not a returning social circle.
Jeffrey Burroughs is a commercial fine jewelry and design studio/boutique; the salon is one of its promotional events, run by the business rather than by a club or membership organization.
